description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of National Botanical Gardens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-30 to appoint Mrs. H.C.P. Jayaweera, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, to act full time in the Post of Director General of the Department of National Botanical Gardens and she has accordingly continued to serve in the said post to date. The Public Service Commission has promoted her to the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service with effect from 2026-01-31. The proposal made by the Minister of Environment to appoint Mrs. H.C.P. Jayaweera to the Post of Director General of the Department of National Botanical Gardens on permanent basis to be effective from the said date, was approved by the Cabinet.
